title: Line sketch: Sunset Rails Over the City
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: An elevated train glides along tracks beneath a dramatic city skyline silhouetted against a blazing sunset. The composition leads the eye from foreground rails and bridges toward the glowing sun and clustered skyscrapers, with layered clouds filling the sky. Bold, loose and vibrant color blocking define the painterly technique (derived from painting #91).
